reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended Both streaming converters incorrectly report STOP instead of TOOL_CALLS when tool calls precede an empty terminal chunk, requiring a fix and regression coverage for both response types.
1 open issue - [Preserve TOOL_CALLS when terminal chunk follows tool calls](https://github.com/microsoft/semantic-kernel/pull/14674#discussion_r4407946831) · New
What changed in this PR This PR updates the Python Ollama chat connector to expose generation finish reasons and preserve usage data when prompt token counts are zero. **Changes:** - Maps Ollama’s `done_reason` to finish reasons for typed and mapping responses, including streaming. - Preserves token usage when counts are zero rather than missing. - Adds tests for finish reasons, terminal streaming chunks, and zero-prompt-token usage. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​ollama/​services/​test_ollama_chat_completion.py` | Adds finish-reason and zero-token usage tests; updates response doubles. | | `python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​ollama/​services/​ollama_chat_completion.py` | Adds finish-reason mapping across response paths and retains zero-token usage. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: When tool calls arrive before an empty terminal chunk with `done_reason="stop"`, the terminal chunk and combined response report `STOP` instead of `TOOL_CALLS`. Include `tool_call_index > 0` alongside the current message's tool-call check in both streaming converters (same issue at line 380). Add regression coverage for a tool-call chunk followed by an empty terminal chunk for both response types.

Confirmed on the current head using the actual mapping converter. A chunk containing `tool_calls=[{"function":{"name":"fn","arguments":{"x":1}}}]`, followed by `{"message":{"content":""},"done_reason":"stop"}` with `tool_call_index=1`, produces finish reasons `None` then `STOP`. Adding the two `StreamingChatMessageContent` objects keeps the function call but reports `STOP`, not `TOOL_CALLS`. Both streaming converters need to account for tool calls from earlier chunks; please add this two-chunk regression case.

comments.body:
Thanks, confirmed. Both streaming converters now treat `tool_call_index > 0` (tool calls already emitted earlier in the stream) like the current chunk's own tool calls, so an empty terminal chunk with `done_reason="stop"` reports `TOOL_CALLS`. Added a two-chunk regression test for each response type (typed `ChatResponse` and mapping); both fail without the change and the Ollama unit suite passes (8937fa503).

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
